## What problem would this solve?

Describe the workflow, limitation, or repeated manual task behind the request.
Concrete examples are especially helpful.

## Proposed behavior

Explain what you would like the application to do. If the request changes sync
or navigation behavior, describe the expected result.

## Scope and safety

Which NetBox objects or local files would be affected? Note any configuration
option or safeguard that should accompany the feature.

## Alternatives considered

Mention current workarounds or other approaches you considered and why they do
not meet the need.

## Additional context

Add examples, screenshots, API references, or links to related issues. Remove
credentials and identifying infrastructure data before submitting.
